title: Scaffolding Foundation Models into Physical-World Agents Pushes the Frontier of Long-Horizon Navigation
abstract: arXiv:2608.30396v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Long-horizon physical-world agents must reason over distant goals while grounding decisions in reliable closed-loop behavior. Today's foundation models split these capabilities: vision-language models (VLMs) infer missing information and adapt high-level plans but remain brittle and inefficient at repeated navigation grounding, while navigation foundation models (NFMs) robustly execute semantic goals but operate as bounded episodes without persistent task-level reasoning. We introduce NavMCP, an agentic scaffolding framework that couples a VLM reasoning agent with an NFM executor for long-horizon exploration. The VLM decides what evidence to seek, where to search, and when to stop, while the NFM grounds each semantic sub-goal into closed-loop navigation. translated_title: 将基础模型搭建为物理世界智能体，推动长时程导航的前沿
translated_abstract: 长时程物理世界智能体必须既能对远距离目标进行推理，又能将决策建立在可靠的闭环行为之上。当今的基础模型将这些能力割裂开来：视觉-语言模型（VLM）能够推断缺失信息并调整高层计划，但在反复进行导航落地时仍然脆弱且低效；而导航基础模型（NFM）能够稳健地执行语义目标，却以有界回合的方式运行，缺乏持久的任务级推理。我们提出NavMCP，一个将VLM推理智能体与NFM执行器相耦合、用于长时程探索的智能体脚手架框架。VLM决定寻找什么证据、在哪里搜索以及何时停止，而NFM将每个语义子目标落地为闭环导航。三个通道构建了二者的协作：意图通道将证据需求转化为导航调用，观察通道将执行过程转化为基于来源的轨迹证据，记忆通道……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出NavMCP智能体脚手架框架，将负责高层推理与证据搜索决策的视觉-语言模型与负责闭环导航执行的导航基础模型相耦合，通过意图、观察、记忆三个协作通道实现长时程物理世界导航探索。
en_tdlr: NavMCP is an agentic scaffolding framework that couples a VLM reasoning agent with an NFM executor through intent, observation, and memory channels, pushing the frontier of long-horizon physical-world navigation by combining high-level evidence-seeking reasoning with robust closed-loop navigation grounding.
